shots.frame: Close-up shot: a large industrial DCS computer monitor in the control room, displaying glowing yellow alert warning banners, fluctuating diagnostic graphs, and pulsing yellow warning icons on a dark UI screen. No people.
shots.action: The camera holds on the glowing yellow warning screen as diagnostic graphs pulse and warning icons flicker continuously.

line.text: 不可能啊！進料流量跟壓力完全正常，到底哪台伺服器在鬧脾氣？！

shots.frame: Medium shot waist-up: the man with glasses from <image1> sits behind the curved console desk in the control room from <image2>, typing frantically on the keyboard, looking up at the glowing monitors with sweaty forehead and anxious, panicked eyes.
shots.action: The stressed engineer taps the keyboard frantically with trembling fingers, shouting in panic at the monitors.

line.text: 陳工啊，年輕人火氣別太大。歲修重啟順順跑就好，慌什麼？

shots.frame: Medium shot: the older man with yellow hard hat from <image1> pushes open the control room door, holding a silver stainless steel vacuum flask, smiling calmly and blowing gently across the rim of the steaming cup.
shots.action: The veteran operator walks casually into the room, chuckles warmly, and sips from his flask with complete relaxation.

line.text: 班長！核心系統通訊全斷，再五分鐘找不到原因就要連鎖跳俥了！

shots.frame: Medium shot: the engineer with glasses from <image1> stands abruptly up from his swivel chair, pointing with high agitation at the flashing amber computer screen, shouting with wild eyes.
shots.action: The engineer springs out of his chair, waving his arms toward the blinking screens in utter exasperation.

shots.frame: Extreme close-up shot: resting flat on top of the black metallic industrial server rack from <image1>, there is a single brand-new, completely sealed, unopened and pristine puffy bright yellow snack bag, resting where sacred equipment usually sits. Blinking amber and green LEDs cast light upon the intact sealed bag. No people.
shots.action: Slow slight tilt down emphasizing the pristine unopened yellow snack bag sitting quietly atop the humming server rack under amber lights.

line.text: 噗！天啊……誰幹的？！誰動了鎮廠神物？！

shots.frame: Close-up shot: Lao Li, the older operator with yellow hard hat from <image1>, face distorted in comical shock with cheeks puffed, spraying a violent dramatic jet of water droplets forward out of his mouth in an epic spit-take, dropping his stainless steel flask.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Lao Li suddenly gasps in horror and violently sprays an explosive torrent of tea water straight forward out of his wide-open mouth in a classic comedy spit-take. Dense water mist and fine splashing droplets burst across the camera frame. His head jerks backward in recoil, his eyes bulge wide with trembling terror, and his hands flail wildly while dropping the thermos flask onto the console desk.

line.text: 班長，我剛剛看那包綠色過期半年了，好心幫你們換一包新鮮的，黃色象徵大發財耶！

shots.frame: Medium shot: the young rookie operator with yellow hard hat from <image1> walks cheerfully into the control room holding an open bright green bag of snacks, munching happily with a proud, innocent grin.
shots.action: The rookie munches on a green bag snack enthusiastically, gesticulating happily with the open green bag and explaining his great deed.

line.text: 發什麼財！黃色是警示燈啊！綠色才是通行順暢！你把護廠結界給吃了？！

shots.frame: Medium shot: the veteran operator from <image1> lunges forward with bulging furious eyes, gripping two hands in the air shouting with exasperation in the control room.
shots.action: The older operator steps aggressively forward, shaking both fists and bellowing in furious disbelief.

line.text: 又跳掉一台！只剩三分鐘！買不到綠色我們三個明天通通去跟廠長提頭來見！

shots.frame: Close-up shot: the engineer with glasses from <image1> clutching his head with both hands, screaming upward in agony, glowing red and amber reflections bouncing off his spectacles.
shots.action: The engineer clutches his temples and groans loudly in total existential despair.

line.text: 我現在騎車去福利社！誰都不要攔我！

shots.frame: Medium shot: the rookie operator from <image1>, face turning pale with sheer terror, tosses the snack bag aside and snaps his yellow hard hat strap tight under chin, turning toward the door.
shots.action: The rookie gasps in horror, fastens his helmet strap with jerky haste, and bolts toward the exit.

shots.frame: Wide shot tracking: the rookie operator from <image1> in yellow helmet furiously pedaling an old rusty industrial utility bicycle along the wet refinery road between massive cracking towers, feet blurred with speed. No captions.
shots.action: The rookie pedals the bicycle furiously down the industrial plant road, leaning forward desperately.

line.text: 福利社沒開就去市區超商買！一定要椰子口味！買黃色或紅色的你不用回來了！

shots.frame: Medium close-up shot: the older operator with yellow hard hat from <image1> yelling furiously into a black handheld two-way radio walkie-talkie, neck veins bulging, pointing violently toward the window.
shots.action: The older operator barks frantically into the walkie-talkie, trembling with urgency.

shots.frame: Cinematic wide shot: at the plant security gate from <image1>, the silhouette of the young worker with yellow hard hat on a bicycle is halted by an unmoving security guard with a clipboard. The worker waves his arms hysterically. Dramatic cloudy sky.
shots.action: The cyclist flails his arms frantically while the guard calmly raises a hand, frozen in comical standoff.
